DATE: 12 Jan 2026
COUNTRY: India
SITE: Reliance Jamnagar Refinery Complex, Gujarat
REFINERY_ZONE: Crude Distillation Unit (CDU)
FUNCTION: Refining Operations
ACTIVITY: Production operations
CAUSE: Process upset / loss of containment potential
PRIMARY LIFE-SAVING RULE: Process safety / line of fire
NARRATIVE:
During routine CDU operation, operators observed an abnormal pressure rise on a crude preheat train. The control room initiated the approved response and reduced feed rate while field personnel verified valve and instrument status. No release or injury occurred. The event was escalated as a high-potential near miss because continued pressure escalation could have resulted in equipment damage and hydrocarbon release.
WHAT WENT WRONG:
The abnormal trend was not identified as early as expected during the initial operating review.
CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Review alarm response expectations, verify instrumentation health, and reinforce operating-envelope checks before continuing at normal throughput.

DATE: 18 Jan 2026
COUNTRY: India
SITE: Reliance Jamnagar Refinery Complex, Gujarat
REFINERY_ZONE: FCC / Coker Area
FUNCTION: Refining Operations
ACTIVITY: Maintenance, inspection, testing
CAUSE: Stored energy
PRIMARY LIFE-SAVING RULE: Energy isolation
NARRATIVE:
During preparation for maintenance on process equipment in the FCC area, residual pressure was identified after the first isolation step. Work was stopped and the equipment was positively isolated and depressurized before maintenance began. No injury occurred.
WHAT WENT WRONG:
The initial isolation verification did not identify the residual energy condition.
CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Strengthen isolation verification, require documented zero-energy confirmation, and review the permit before work starts.

DATE: 24 Jan 2026
COUNTRY: India
SITE: Reliance Jamnagar Refinery Complex, Gujarat
REFINERY_ZONE: Tank Farm
FUNCTION: Storage Operations
ACTIVITY: Transfer and loading operations
CAUSE: Vehicle / road hazard
PRIMARY LIFE-SAVING RULE: Driving
NARRATIVE:
A road tanker approached a designated transfer area at excessive speed and required abrupt braking near an active loading lane. No contact or injury occurred. The movement was stopped and the driver was briefed.
WHAT WENT WRONG:
Speed-control expectations and vehicle approach controls were not followed.
CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Reinforce site traffic controls, verify route signage, and increase supervision during tanker movements.

DATE: 31 Jan 2026
COUNTRY: India
SITE: Reliance Jamnagar Refinery Complex, Gujarat
REFINERY_ZONE: Marine / Product Loading Area
FUNCTION: Logistics
ACTIVITY: Lifting, crane, rigging, deck operations
CAUSE: Lifting hazard
PRIMARY LIFE-SAVING RULE: Line of fire
NARRATIVE:
During movement of maintenance material near the product loading interface, a suspended load rotated unexpectedly after a change in wind direction. The lifting operation was stopped before personnel entered the load path. No injury occurred.
WHAT WENT WRONG:
The exclusion zone was smaller than required for the potential load movement.
CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Review lifting plans, enlarge exclusion zones where required, and reinforce line-of-fire controls.

DATE: 06 Feb 2026
COUNTRY: India
SITE: Reliance Jamnagar Refinery Complex, Gujarat
REFINERY_ZONE: Utilities / Power Area
FUNCTION: Utilities
ACTIVITY: Electrical maintenance
CAUSE: Electrical energy
PRIMARY LIFE-SAVING RULE: Energy isolation
NARRATIVE:
An electrical maintenance team identified an unexpected energized indication during pre-work verification on a utility distribution panel. Work was stopped immediately and the circuit was isolated and tested again.
WHAT WENT WRONG:
The first verification step was not sufficient to establish a confirmed de-energized condition.
CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Reinforce test-before-touch requirements and independent verification for electrical isolation.

DATE: 14 Feb 2026
COUNTRY: India
SITE: Reliance Jamnagar Refinery Complex, Gujarat
REFINERY_ZONE: Hydroprocessing Area
FUNCTION: Refining Operations
ACTIVITY: Maintenance, inspection, testing
CAUSE: Dropped object
PRIMARY LIFE-SAVING RULE: Line of fire
NARRATIVE:
During inspection work at an elevated platform, a small hand tool slipped from a work position and was stopped by the secondary retention arrangement. No person was below the platform and no injury occurred.
WHAT WENT WRONG:
Tool tethering was not applied consistently to every item taken to the elevated work position.
CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Standardize tool retention checks and reinforce dropped-object prevention before elevated work.

DATE: 22 Feb 2026
COUNTRY: India
SITE: Reliance Jamnagar Refinery Complex, Gujarat
REFINERY_ZONE: Aromatics / Paraxylene Area
FUNCTION: Process Operations
ACTIVITY: Production operations
CAUSE: Process parameter deviation
PRIMARY LIFE-SAVING RULE: Work authorization
NARRATIVE:
A process parameter moved outside the normal operating band during routine production. The operator followed the response procedure, stabilized the unit, and notified the shift supervisor. No release or injury occurred.
WHAT WENT WRONG:
The deviation was recognized later than expected because trend review was not performed at the planned interval.
CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Reinforce operating-trend review and shift handover expectations.

DATE: 01 Mar 2026
COUNTRY: India
SITE: Reliance Jamnagar Refinery Complex, Gujarat
REFINERY_ZONE: Maintenance Workshop
FUNCTION: Maintenance
ACTIVITY: Maintenance, inspection, testing
CAUSE: Inadequate hazard identification or risk assessment
PRIMARY LIFE-SAVING RULE: Work authorization
NARRATIVE:
Before a planned equipment repair, the crew identified an unplanned pinch point created by the proposed work position. The task was paused and the job plan was revised before work resumed.
WHAT WENT WRONG:
The original job hazard analysis did not fully consider the temporary work position.
CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Improve task-level risk assessment and require field verification of the work position.

DATE: 09 Mar 2026
COUNTRY: India
SITE: Reliance Jamnagar Refinery Complex, Gujarat
REFINERY_ZONE: Gasification / Petcoke Handling Area
FUNCTION: Process Operations
ACTIVITY: Material handling
CAUSE: Dropped object
PRIMARY LIFE-SAVING RULE: Line of fire
NARRATIVE:
A material-handling container shifted during positioning near the petcoke handling area. The load was stabilized before entering the final position and no person was struck.
WHAT WENT WRONG:
The load path was not fully controlled during the initial positioning.
CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Review material-handling plans and reinforce exclusion zones around moving loads.

DATE: 17 Mar 2026
COUNTRY: India
SITE: Reliance Jamnagar Refinery Complex, Gujarat
REFINERY_ZONE: Tank Farm
FUNCTION: Storage Operations
ACTIVITY: Inspection and testing
CAUSE: Inadequate hazard identification or risk assessment
PRIMARY LIFE-SAVING RULE: Work authorization
NARRATIVE:
A planned inspection identified that temporary vehicle movement could conflict with a maintenance work area. The inspection was paused and the access route was revised.
WHAT WENT WRONG:
The interaction between simultaneous vehicle and maintenance activities was not fully captured in the initial risk assessment.
CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Coordinate simultaneous operations and include traffic interaction in task risk assessments.

DATE: 26 Mar 2026

SITE: Reliance Jamnagar Refinery Complex, Gujarat
REFINERY_ZONE: Marine / Product Loading Area
FUNCTION: Logistics
ACTIVITY: Transport - Land
CAUSE: Vehicle / road hazard
PRIMARY LIFE-SAVING RULE: Driving
NARRATIVE:
A service vehicle entered a restricted loading approach during a shift change. The vehicle was stopped before reaching the active work area.
WHAT WENT WRONG:
The driver did not receive the updated temporary traffic arrangement during handover.
CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Improve shift-change traffic communication and verify temporary route controls.

FUNCTION: Refining Operations
ACTIVITY: Lifting, crane, rigging, deck operations
CAUSE: Lifting hazard
PRIMARY LIFE-SAVING RULE: Safe mechanical lifting
NARRATIVE:
A crane-assisted maintenance lift in the FCC area was stopped after the load began to rotate outside the expected path. No person was inside the exclusion zone.
WHAT WENT WRONG:
The lift plan did not sufficiently account for changing load orientation during the final movement.
CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Update lifting plans and require a pre-lift review of load behavior and exclusion zones.

DATE: 12 Apr 2026

FUNCTION: Maintenance
ACTIVITY: Maintenance, inspection, testing

CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Require documented zero-energy checks at the point of work.

Increase field verification of work boundaries during active maintenance.

Strengthen shift handover documentation for temporary process conditions.

Add lifting-accessory verification to the pre-job checklist.
